svg.aria-label: Top, a d by d update Delta W written as a sum of r rank-one terms u1 v1 transpose plus u2 v2 transpose plus up to u_r v_r transpose. Each term is drawn as a thin column u times a thin row v transpose giving a full square whose every row is a multiple of v transpose. Bottom, stacking the r columns side by side gives B of size d by r, and stacking the r rows gives A of size r by d, so Delta W equals B A equals the sum of u_i v_i transpose. Any rank r matrix can be written this way, and r is the fewest terms that work, which is what rank r means. Side note, Delta W x always lands in the span of u1 to u_r, so the update can push in only r directions, for example d 4096 and r 16.
